title: Smoke Over Brindle Ford
recap: Last time, our heroes followed the river road to Brindle Ford and found the old mill in flames. Kael charged into the smoke and carried Old Marta, the tavern keeper, to safety, while Ivy spotted a hooded rider fleeing north. In the ashes they found a black feather token, warm to the touch. Marta begged them to stay the night, warning that this was the third fire in a month. As the party bedded down above the tavern, Ivy heard wingbeats on the roof.
keyMoments: The party reached Brindle Ford as the mill burned
Kael rescued Old Marta from the fire
Ivy saw a hooded rider escape north
The party found a warm black feather token in the ashes
Marta revealed this was the third fire this month
